description: This Java class serves as a command handler in a Fineract-based application, specifically handling the creation of client identifiers. It processes create commands, interacts with the service layer to add a new client identifier, and is annotated with Spring annotations for service declaration, transaction management, and command type specification.

classes.name: CreateClientIdentifierCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles commands to create new client identifiers within the application. It implements processCommand, delegating the creation to the specific service.

methods.name: CreateClientIdentifierCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the client identifier write platform service dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a create command for a client identifier by delegating to the service layer.
